title: Privacy Policy
introduction: Adventurecarz ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website, browse our vehicle fleet, submit an enquiry form, or contact us through WhatsApp.
By using our website, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy. Where required by applicable law, we will obtain consent before processing your personal information.

sections.title: 1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
blocks: Adventurecarz may collect the following information when you use our website or contact us.
1.1 Information Submitted Through Enquiry Forms
When you submit an enquiry through our website, we may collect:

Full name
Mobile number
Email address, if requested
Preferred vehicle
Intended rental dates
Pickup and drop-off locations
Any additional information you provide through the enquiry form
This information helps us understand your requirements and respond to your booking enquiry.
1.2 Information Shared Through WhatsApp
Our website provides WhatsApp links or buttons that allow visitors to contact us directly.
If you contact us through WhatsApp, we may receive your phone number, profile information made available through the service, and any messages or information you choose to share.
1.3 Technical Information

When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected, depending on the website features and tools in use. This may include your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and website usage data.
This information may help us understand how visitors interact with our website and improve its performance.

sections.title: 2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
blocks: Adventurecarz may use the information collected to:

Respond to customer enquiries and booking requests.
Provide information about available vehicles and rental services.
Contact customers regarding vehicle availability, rental dates, and booking requirements.
Coordinate pickup and drop-off arrangements.
Respond to customer questions and provide support.
Maintain enquiry records and manage customer communications.
Improve our website, vehicle listings, and customer experience.
Understand website traffic and measure marketing performance, where applicable tools are enabled.
Prevent fraudulent, unauthorized, or abusive activities.
Comply with applicable legal obligations.
We process personal information for legitimate purposes connected with our services and in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: 3. ENQUIRY FORMS AND BOOKING PROCESS
blocks: The Adventurecarz website allows visitors to browse available vehicles and submit an enquiry through the website's contact or booking enquiry form.
When a customer submits a form, the information provided may be used by our team to contact the customer, discuss vehicle availability, clarify rental requirements, and explain the booking process.
Submitting an enquiry does not automatically confirm a booking or guarantee vehicle availability.
Our team will contact the customer to discuss availability and the next steps.

The website does not currently provide an online payment facility. Customers should contact Adventurecarz directly for information about rental charges, security deposits, payment arrangements, and other booking requirements.

sections.title: 4. WHATSAPP COMMUNICATION
blocks: Adventurecarz provides WhatsApp links or buttons on its website to make it easier for customers to contact us.
Clicking a WhatsApp button may redirect you to WhatsApp, a third-party messaging service operated by Meta.
Information shared through WhatsApp may be used by Adventurecarz to:

Respond to enquiries.
Share vehicle availability and rental information.
Discuss booking requirements.
Coordinate pickup and drop-off arrangements.
Provide customer support.
Your use of WhatsApp is also subject to WhatsApp's applicable terms and privacy policy.
Adventurecarz does not control the independent privacy practices of WhatsApp or other third-party services.
Customers should avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive personal information through messaging platforms.

sections.title: 5. COOKIES AND WEBSITE ANALYTICS
blocks: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to maintain website functionality, understand visitor behaviour, and improve our services.
Depending on the tools implemented, these technologies may help us:

Understand how visitors navigate the website.
Identify technical issues and improve website performance.
Understand which vehicle listings receive attention.
Measure website traffic and visitor engagement.
Evaluate marketing and advertising performance.
Third-party analytics or advertising tools may also collect certain technical information when enabled.
Visitors can manage cookies through their browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect some website features.
Where required by applicable law, consent will be obtained before using non-essential cookies or tracking technologies.

sections.title: 6. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
blocks: Adventurecarz may use third-party service providers to support website operations, customer communication, analytics, advertising, and other business functions.
Depending on the services implemented, these may include:

Website hosting and infrastructure providers.
Providers responsible for handling website enquiry forms.
Communication platforms such as WhatsApp.
Website analytics services.
Digital advertising and campaign measurement platforms.
These providers may process relevant information as necessary to deliver their services, subject to applicable terms and legal requirements.
Adventurecarz does not control the independent privacy practices of third-party platforms. We encourage customers to review the relevant privacy policies when using those services.

sections.title: 7. SHARING OF PERSONAL INFORMATION
blocks: Adventurecarz does not sell customers' personal information.
We may share relevant information with third parties when reasonably necessary for the following purposes:
Service Providers: To support website hosting, enquiry management, communication, and business operations.
Legal Requirements: When disclosure is required by applicable law, regulation, court order, or a lawful request from a competent authority.
Security and Fraud Prevention: When necessary to investigate suspected fraud, protect our customers, or safeguard our business and legal rights.
We aim to limit information sharing to what is reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

sections.title: 8. DATA STORAGE AND RETENTION
blocks: Adventurecarz retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to enquiries, manage customer communications, maintain business records, resolve disputes, and comply with applicable legal requirements.
Retention periods may vary depending on the nature of the information and the purpose for which it was collected.
When personal information is no longer required, we will take reasonable steps to delete it or securely dispose of it, subject to applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: 9. DATA SECURITY
blocks: Adventurecarz takes reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, and misuse.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Customers should avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive information through website forms or messaging platforms.

sections.title: 10. YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS
blocks: Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

Request access to your personal information.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion of personal information where legally permissible.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Raise concerns about how your personal information is handled.
Exercise other rights available under applicable data protection laws.
To exercise these rights, please contact Adventurecarz using the contact details provided below.
We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests. Some information may need to be retained where required by law.

sections.title: 11. THIRD-PARTY LINKS
blocks: Our website may contain links to third-party websites, social media platforms, or external services.
These third-party services operate independently and may have their own privacy policies and practices.

Adventurecarz is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites. We encourage visitors to review the relevant policies before sharing personal information with third-party services.

sections.title: 12. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
blocks: Our car rental services are intended for individuals who meet the applicable legal requirements for renting and driving a vehicle.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children where such collection is prohibited by applicable law.
Any personal information collected in connection with our services will be handled in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 13. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY
blocks: Adventurecarz may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website, services, business practices, or applicable legal requirements.
Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
We encourage visitors to review this page periodically to remain informed about how their information is handled.

sections.title: 14. CONTACT US
blocks: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal information, please contact us using the details below.

title: Terms & Conditions
introduction: Welcome to Adventurecarz. These Terms & Conditions govern your access to and use of our website and the car rental services we offer.
By accessing our website, browsing our vehicle listings, submitting an enquiry, or contacting us regarding our services, you agree to these Terms & Conditions.
Please read them carefully before using our website or requesting a vehicle rental.

sections.title: 1. ABOUT OUR SERVICES
blocks: Adventurecarz provides self-drive car rental services in Guwahati, Assam, and surrounding areas, subject to vehicle availability and the applicable rental arrangements.
Our website allows visitors to:

Browse available vehicles.
View vehicle details and rental-related information.
Submit an enquiry through the website form.
Contact our team through WhatsApp or other available contact channels.
Submitting an enquiry does not constitute a confirmed booking. Our team will contact you to discuss vehicle availability, rental dates, pricing, documentation, and other applicable requirements.
A rental is confirmed only after Adventurecarz communicates its acceptance of the booking and the applicable rental requirements have been fulfilled.

sections.title: 2. ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS
blocks: Customers requesting a self-drive rental must meet the applicable legal requirements for renting and driving a vehicle.
Customers may be required to:

Hold a valid driving licence appropriate for the vehicle being rented.
Provide valid identification documents.
Meet the minimum age requirements applicable to the rental.
Provide accurate personal and contact information.
Satisfy any additional reasonable eligibility requirements communicated by Adventurecarz.
Adventurecarz reserves the right to decline a rental request if the customer does not meet the applicable legal or rental eligibility requirements.

sections.title: 3. VEHICLE AVAILABILITY
blocks: All vehicles displayed on our website are subject to availability.
Vehicle listings, photographs, specifications, and other information are provided to help customers explore our fleet.
Availability may change depending on existing bookings, maintenance, operational requirements, or other circumstances.
Adventurecarz does not guarantee that a particular vehicle will be available on a requested date until the booking has been confirmed.
If a requested vehicle becomes unavailable, our team may discuss alternative vehicles or arrangements with the customer.

sections.title: 4. ENQUIRIES AND BOOKING CONFIRMATION
blocks: Customers can request rental information through our website enquiry form or by contacting Adventurecarz through WhatsApp or other available communication channels.
Customers are responsible for providing accurate information, including their contact details, preferred vehicle, rental dates, and pickup or drop-off requirements.
After receiving an enquiry, our team may contact the customer to clarify requirements and communicate availability, pricing, documentation requirements, and the next steps.
An enquiry, WhatsApp conversation, or submission of personal information does not automatically guarantee a reservation.
The applicable rental terms will be communicated before the rental is finalized.

sections.title: 5. RENTAL PRICING AND PAYMENT
blocks: Rental prices may vary depending on the vehicle, rental duration, demand, availability, and other applicable conditions.
The applicable rental charges and any additional fees will be communicated directly to the customer before the booking is finalized.

Our website does not currently process online payments. Customers should contact Adventurecarz directly for information about payment methods, rental charges, security deposits, and other applicable fees.
Customers should clarify the total applicable charges and payment requirements with our team before confirming a rental.
Any agreed rental charges, deposits, or other amounts will be governed by the terms communicated and accepted during the booking process.

sections.title: 6. CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY
blocks: Cancellation requests, refund eligibility, and any applicable deductions will be handled according to the cancellation and refund terms communicated to the customer before the booking is finalized.
Customers wishing to cancel or modify a confirmed booking should contact Adventurecarz as soon as possible.
Any applicable cancellation charges, refund timelines, and deductions will depend on the agreed rental terms and applicable law.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions excludes any consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.
For further information, customers may contact Adventurecarz through the official contact details provided on our website.

sections.title: 7. CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES
blocks: Customers renting a vehicle from Adventurecarz are expected to:

Provide accurate information and valid documents.
Use the vehicle lawfully and responsibly.
Comply with applicable traffic laws and road safety requirements.
Ensure that only authorized and eligible drivers operate the vehicle.
Follow the agreed rental duration and usage conditions.
Take reasonable care of the vehicle during the rental period.
Report accidents, damage, theft, mechanical problems, or other significant incidents promptly.
Return the vehicle according to the agreed return arrangements.
Customers must not use a rental vehicle for unlawful activities or in any manner prohibited by applicable law or the agreed rental conditions.
Additional vehicle-specific or rental-specific responsibilities may be communicated before the rental is finalized.

sections.title: 8. VEHICLE DAMAGE, ACCIDENTS AND TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS
blocks: Customers must promptly inform Adventurecarz of any accident, damage, theft, breakdown, or other significant incident involving a rental vehicle.
Customers must cooperate with reasonable reporting, documentation, insurance, and legal procedures relating to such incidents.

Responsibility for damage, loss, traffic violations, penalties, or other charges will be determined according to applicable law, the circumstances of the incident, relevant insurance terms, and the rental agreement.
Customers should clarify the applicable damage, insurance, and liability conditions before accepting a vehicle.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions creates liability beyond what is permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: 9. PICKUP AND RETURN OF VEHICLES
blocks: Vehicle pickup and return arrangements will be communicated directly to the customer during the booking process.
Customers should follow the agreed pickup and return times and locations.
Any request to change a pickup location, return location, rental duration, or other booking detail should be communicated to Adventurecarz in advance and is subject to approval.
Additional charges may apply where permitted by the agreed rental terms.
Customers should clarify the procedure for late returns, extensions, and vehicle handover before finalizing a booking.

sections.title: 10. WEBSITE INFORMATION AND ACCURACY
blocks: Adventurecarz makes reasonable efforts to ensure that the information presented on its website is accurate and up to date.
However, vehicle availability, photographs, specifications, descriptions, and other information may change.
Website content is provided for general informational purposes and does not independently guarantee vehicle availability, a particular rental price, or a confirmed reservation.
Customers should verify important details directly with Adventurecarz before finalizing a rental.

sections.title: 11. WEBSITE USE
blocks: Visitors agree to use the Adventurecarz website lawfully and responsibly.
You must not:

Use the website for fraudulent or unlawful purposes.
Submit false, misleading, or unauthorized enquiries.
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to the website or its systems.
Interfere with website functionality or security.
Introduce malicious software or engage in activities that could damage the website.
Adventurecarz reserves the right to take reasonable measures to protect its website and business from misuse.

sections.title: 12. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES AND LINKS
blocks: Our website may contain links to third-party platforms, including WhatsApp and social media services.
These platforms operate independently and are governed by their own terms, conditions, and privacy policies.
Adventurecarz is not responsible for the availability, content, or independent practices of third-party services.
Customers who use such services do so subject to the applicable third-party terms.

sections.title: 13. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
blocks: Adventurecarz will take reasonable steps to maintain accurate website information and provide its services responsibly.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, Adventurecarz will not be responsible for losses arising solely from temporary website unavailability, technical interruptions, inaccurate third-party information, or circumstances beyond its reasonable control.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions excludes or limits liability where such exclusion or limitation is prohibited by applicable law.
Any liability arising from a confirmed vehicle rental will be governed by the applicable rental agreement, relevant insurance terms, and applicable law.

sections.title: 14. CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
blocks: Adventurecarz may update these Terms & Conditions to reflect changes in its services, website functionality, business operations, or legal requirements.
Updated terms will be published on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
Visitors are encouraged to review this page periodically.
Changes to the terms of an already confirmed rental will be subject to the applicable agreement and law.

sections.title: 15. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
blocks: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws applicable in India.
Subject to applicable law, disputes relating to these website terms will fall within the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Guwahati, Assam.
Nothing in this section limits any mandatory legal rights or remedies available to customers.

title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
introduction: At Adventurecarz, we understand that travel plans can change. This Cancellation & Refund Policy explains how cancellation requests, booking changes, and refund-related enquiries are handled for our self-drive car rental services in Guwahati, Assam, and surrounding areas.
We aim to handle all cancellation and refund requests fairly and communicate the applicable terms clearly to our customers.

sections.title: 1. ENQUIRIES AND BOOKING CONFIRMATION
blocks: Customers can browse our vehicle fleet and submit an enquiry through the Adventurecarz website or contact us through WhatsApp.
Submitting an enquiry does not constitute a confirmed booking and does not create an automatic entitlement to a refund.
Our team will contact the customer to discuss vehicle availability, rental charges, booking requirements, and the next steps.
A booking is considered confirmed only after Adventurecarz communicates its acceptance and the applicable booking requirements have been fulfilled.

sections.title: 2. CANCELLATION BY THE CUSTOMER
blocks: Customers who wish to cancel a confirmed booking should contact Adventurecarz as soon as possible using the official contact details provided on our website.
When requesting a cancellation, customers should provide their name, registered contact number, rental dates, and relevant booking details.
Cancellation requests will be reviewed according to the terms communicated and agreed upon when the booking was finalized.
Any applicable cancellation charges, deductions, or refund eligibility will depend on the agreed booking terms and applicable law.
Customers are encouraged to contact our team promptly if their travel plans change.

sections.title: 3. CANCELLATION BY ADVENTURECARZ
blocks: Adventurecarz may need to cancel or modify a confirmed booking in exceptional circumstances, including:

The requested vehicle becoming unavailable.
Unexpected vehicle maintenance or mechanical issues.
Operational difficulties or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
Safety, legal, or eligibility requirements that prevent the rental from proceeding.
Where possible, we will inform the affected customer promptly and discuss suitable alternatives.
If Adventurecarz cancels a confirmed booking and cannot provide an agreed alternative, any refund due will be handled according to the agreed booking terms and applicable law.

sections.title: 4. REFUND ELIGIBILITY
blocks: Refund eligibility depends on the circumstances of the cancellation and the terms agreed upon when the booking was confirmed.
Where a customer has paid an amount directly to Adventurecarz in connection with a confirmed booking, any applicable refund will be assessed according to the agreed cancellation terms.
The customer will be informed of any applicable deductions or charges before the refund is processed, where reasonably practicable.
Nothing in this policy excludes consumer rights or refund entitlements that cannot legally be excluded.

sections.title: 5. REFUND PROCESSING TIME
blocks: Where a refund is approved, Adventurecarz will communicate the expected processing timeline to the customer.
The time required to complete a refund may depend on the original payment method, the relevant financial institution, and other applicable processing requirements.
Customers who have questions about an approved refund may contact our team using the details provided below.

sections.title: 6. BOOKING MODIFICATIONS
blocks: Customers who wish to change their rental dates, vehicle selection, pickup location, or return arrangements should contact Adventurecarz as early as possible.
All modification requests are subject to vehicle availability and approval by our team.
Changes may result in revised rental charges or other adjustments, which will be communicated to the customer before the modification is finalized.
A requested change should not be considered confirmed until Adventurecarz communicates its approval.

sections.title: 7. NO-SHOWS AND LATE ARRIVALS
blocks: Customers who cannot arrive at the agreed pickup time should inform Adventurecarz as soon as possible.
Failure to collect a vehicle at the agreed time without prior communication may affect the booking.
Any cancellation charges, deductions, or consequences associated with a missed pickup will depend on the terms communicated and agreed upon when the booking was confirmed.
Customers are encouraged to contact our team promptly if they anticipate a delay.

sections.title: 8. SECURITY DEPOSITS AND OTHER CHARGES
blocks: If a security deposit or any other amount is collected as part of a rental arrangement, its refund eligibility and processing will be governed by the applicable rental agreement.
Any deductions relating to damage, outstanding charges, late returns, or other agreed rental obligations must be assessed according to the rental terms and applicable law.
Customers should clarify the deposit amount, applicable conditions, and refund process with Adventurecarz before finalizing their booking.

sections.title: 9. HOW TO REQUEST A CANCELLATION OR REFUND
blocks: To request a cancellation, booking modification, or refund-related assistance, customers can contact Adventurecarz using the following details:

Business Name: Adventurecarz
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70024 57987 / +91 96784 49177

Website: https://adventurecarz.com/
Please include your name, contact number, rental dates, and booking reference if available.
Our team will review the request and communicate the applicable next steps.

sections.title: 10. POLICY UPDATES
blocks: Adventurecarz reserves the right to update this Cancellation & Refund Policy to reflect changes in its business operations, rental procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
Any revised version will be published on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.
Changes to this policy will not override rights or obligations arising under an existing booking agreement or applicable law.
